technical_requirements: Throughput targets: baseline 2,000 embeddings/sec (batchy offline workloads) and 450 concurrent low-latency chat sessions (interactive traders). Latency SLOs: 95th <120ms for short-turn prompts (chat), 95th <250ms for complex reranking requests. Failover/headroom: active-active across 3 regions (us-east-1, us-west-2, eu-west-1) with 30% spare capacity per region; cross-region failover must sustain >=70% baseline throughput with 95p latency degradation <=2x. Desired reserved GPU plan: prefer per-region reserved pools (initial proposal: 8 A100-equiv GPUs per region for baseline, +2 spare per region for headroom; alternative plan: 12 GPUs/region with 20% buffer). Need clear unit economics for reserved vs burst capacity and defined preemption/fallback policies.
